about.title: About Givea
about.subtitle: We're building a community where giving meets receiving. A platform that transforms unused items into meaningful impact, connecting generous hearts with those who need support most.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.paragraph1: Givea was born from a simple observation: countless people have items they no longer need, while others desperately search for those same items. We saw furniture left on sidewalks, clothes piling up in closets, and electronics gathering dust—all while families struggled to afford basic necessities.
ourStory.paragraph2: In 2025, we decided to bridge this gap. Starting in Morocco, we created a platform that makes giving as easy as posting a photo and receiving as simple as sending a message. No complicated processes, no barriers—just human connection and generosity.
ourStory.paragraph3: Today, Givea is more than a platform. It's a movement of people who believe in the power of community, the value of sustainability, and the joy of helping others. Every donation tells a story, and we're honored to facilitate thousands of these stories every day.

ourMission.title: Our Mission
ourMission.paragraph1: We exist to make generosity accessible and impactful. Our mission is to create a world where resources flow freely to those who need them, where nothing useful goes to waste, and where communities grow stronger through acts of kindness.
ourMission.paragraph2: We believe that technology should serve humanity's best instincts. That's why we've built Givea to be intuitive, secure, and focused entirely on facilitating meaningful connections between donors and beneficiaries. We're not here to profit from charity—we're here to amplify it.

communityFirst.title: Community First
communityFirst.description: Every decision we make prioritizes the people who use Givea. We listen to your feedback, adapt to your needs, and build features that genuinely serve our community. You're not users to us—you're partners in creating positive change.

transparency.title: Transparency & Trust
transparency.description: We operate with complete openness. Your data is yours, your privacy is sacred, and our practices are clear. We build trust not through marketing promises but through consistent, honest action. No hidden agendas, no data selling, no compromises on integrity.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Every item donated through Givea is one less item in a landfill. We're committed to environmental responsibility through circular economy principles. By extending the life of products and reducing waste, we're contributing to a healthier planet for everyone.

dignity.title: Dignity in Giving and Receiving
dignity.description: We've designed Givea to preserve dignity on both sides of every transaction. Donors give with generosity, not pity. Recipients receive with gratitude, not shame. Our platform facilitates peer-to-peer connections that recognize the humanity in everyone.

innovation.title: Innovation for Good
innovation.description: Technology should solve real problems. We continuously innovate to make giving easier, matching smarter, and connections more meaningful. From smart notifications to location-based matching, every feature we build serves our mission of maximizing impact.

step1.title: Create Your Listing
step1.description: Donors snap a photo of items they want to give away, add a quick description, and post. It takes less than 2 minutes. No complicated forms, no verification hassles.

step2.title: Smart Matching
step2.description: Our system notifies nearby users who might need these items. Recipients can browse available donations, filter by category and location, and find exactly what they're looking for.

step3.title: Direct Communication
step3.description: Once matched, donors and recipients chat directly through our secure messaging system to coordinate pickup times, locations, and any other details. Simple, direct, personal.

step4.title: Make the Connection
step4.description: Items change hands, lives get a little better, and nothing useful goes to waste. That's the Givea way—straightforward, impactful, and deeply human.

ourImpact.title: Our Impact
ourImpact.paragraph1: Since launching, Givea has facilitated thousands of successful donations across Morocco. We've helped families furnish their homes, students get school supplies, and communities reduce waste. But numbers only tell part of the story.
ourImpact.paragraph2: The real impact is in the connections made, the gratitude expressed, and the culture of generosity we're building together. Every time someone chooses to give through Givea instead of throwing something away, they're voting for a more compassionate, sustainable world.

theTeam.title: The Team
theTeam.paragraph1: Givea is built by a small, passionate team based in Morocco who believe technology can be a force for good. We're developers, designers, and community builders united by a shared vision: making generosity effortless and impact measurable.
theTeam.paragraph2: We're not venture-backed, we're not chasing explosive growth, and we're not building features for investors. We're building for you—the donors who want to make a difference and the recipients who need support. Every line of code we write serves that mission.
theTeam.paragraph3: We work closely with our community, respond to feedback quickly, and continuously improve Givea based on real user needs. This isn't just our platform—it's ours together.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: At Givea, we're committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about how we handle your information. This policy explains our practices in detail.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: Welcome to Givea. This Privacy Policy describes how Givea ("we," "our," or "us") collects, uses, shares, and protects your personal information when you use our platform. By accessing or using Givea, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
introduction.paragraph2: We operate a community-driven platform where users can donate items they no longer need to those who need them most. Your trust is essential to our mission, and we take your privacy seriously.

youProvide.title: 2.1 Information You Provide
youProvide.description: When you create an account, list items for donation, or communicate with other users, you provide us with information including your name, email address, phone number, profile photo, location, and any content you post such as item descriptions and photos.

automaticallyCollected.title: 2.2 Automatically Collected Information
automaticallyCollected.description: We automatically collect certain information when you use Givea, including your IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, pages visited, time spent on pages, links clicked, and the referring URL. We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect this data.

locationInformation.title: 2.3 Location Information
locationInformation.description: With your permission, we collect precise location data to help match donors with nearby beneficiaries. You can control location permissions through your device settings at any time.

howWeUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.paragraph1: We use the information we collect to provide and improve Givea's services, including facilitating donations between users, personalizing your experience, sending notifications about matching items and messages, preventing fraud and abuse, analyzing platform usage to improve functionality, and communicating with you about updates and features.
howWeUse.paragraph2: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. Your data is used solely to operate our platform and enhance your experience as part of our charitable community.

withOtherUsers.title: 4.1 With Other Users
withOtherUsers.description: When you list items for donation or request items, your profile information and item listings are visible to other Givea users. Direct communication features allow you to exchange messages with matched users to coordinate donations.

serviceProviders.title: 4.2 Service Providers
serviceProviders.description: We share information with trusted third-party service providers who help us operate our platform, such as hosting providers, analytics services, and communication tools. These providers are contractually obligated to protect your data and use it only for specified purposes.

legalRequirements.title: 4.3 Legal Requirements
legalRequirements.description: We may disclose your information if required by law, in response to valid legal processes, to protect the rights and safety of Givea and its users, or to prevent fraud and abuse of our platform.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.paragraph1: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These measures include encryption of data in transit and at rest, secure authentication mechanisms, regular security audits, and restricted access to personal data.
dataSecurity.paragraph2: However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

yourRights.title: 6. Your Rights and Choices
yourRights.paragraph1: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through your account settings. You can opt out of promotional communications while still receiving essential service-related messages. You may disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect platform functionality. You can request a copy of your data or account deletion by contacting us.
yourRights.paragraph2: For users in Morocco and the EU, you have additional rights under applicable data protection laws, including the right to data portability and the right to object to certain processing activities.

childrensPrivacy.title: 7. Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.description: Givea is not intended for users under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we discover that we have inadvertently collected data from a child, we will delete it promptly. Parents or guardians who believe their child has provided us with information should contact us immediately.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.paragraph1: We use cookies, web beacons, and similar technologies to enhance your experience, remember your preferences, understand how you use our platform, and analyze traffic patterns. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings.
cookies.paragraph2: We use essential cookies for platform functionality, analytics cookies to understand usage patterns, and preference cookies to remember your settings and choices.

internationalTransfers.title: 9. International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.description: Givea is based in Morocco. If you access our platform from outside Morocco, your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in Morocco or other countries where our service providers operate. By using Givea, you consent to the transfer of your information to countries that may have different data protection laws than your country of residence.

changesToPolicy.title: 10. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToPolicy.description: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of significant changes by posting a notice on our platform or sending you an email. The "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy indicates when it was most recently revised. Your continued use of Givea after changes become effective constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.description: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
contact.responseTimeValue: We aim to respond to all inquiries within 72 hours.

itemListings.paragraph2: You retain ownership of items until they are successfully transferred to a recipient. Givea does not take ownership of any items listed on the platform.

seedRewardSystem.title: 5. Seed Reward System

seedRewardSystem.listItem1: New users receive 10 free seeds upon registration
seedRewardSystem.listItem2: Seeds are deducted when you contact other users or request items (1 seed per action)
